description_en: Bindsan upstream identity provider to a specified instance and triggers a synchronization task
description_zh: 为指定实例绑定上游身份提供商并触发同步任务
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams bind-identity-provider --instance-id agentteams-xxx --identity-provider-type DingTalk --idp-metadata appKey_:_dingxxxx_,_appSecret_:_xxxxx_,_corpId_:_dingxxxx_,_encryptKey_:_xxxxx_,_verificationToken_:_xxxxx --login-enabled true --sync-enabled true --client-token ct-1234abcd --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The identity provider type. Currently, only DingTalk is supported
parameters.help_zh: 身份提供商类型，目前仅支持钉钉
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

parameters.help_en: The identity provider metadata. In DingTalk scenarios, this is a JSON object string that contains the `appKey`, `appSecret`, `corpId`, `encryptKey`, and `verificationToken` fields. This is a sensitive parameter
parameters.help_zh: 身份提供商元数据，钉钉场景下为 JSON 对象字符串，包含 `appKey`、`appSecret`、`corpId`、`encryptKey`、`verificationToken` 字段。该参数为敏感参数
parameters.name: idp_metadata

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable logon. Default value: `true`
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启登录，不传或为空时默认为 `true`
parameters.name: login_enabled

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable user synchronization. Default value: `false`. User synchronization is enabled only when this parameter is explicitly set to `true`
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启用户同步，不传时默认为 `false`，仅当显式传 `true` 时开启
parameters.name: sync_enabled

parameters.help_en: The client idempotency token that ensures the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 客户端幂等令牌，用于保证请求幂等性
parameters.name: client_token
